facts.fact: Loi n° 2022-010 of 24 June 2022, adopted by the National Assembly and promulgated by the President, amends articles 3, 13, 14, 14 bis, 14 ter and 20 of Loi n° 2020-009 of 10 September 2020 on biometric identification of natural persons in Togo; it is a promulgated act of law.
facts.system: Loi n° 2020-009 du 10 septembre 2020 relative à l'identification biométrique des personnes physiques au Togo, modifiée par la loi n° 2022-010 du 24 juin 2022

facts.fact: The amended law defines a unique identification number (NIU) issued by the national identification agency after verification of demographic and biometric data, and a central database holding all NIU with the matching data, against which the NIU and data are authenticated electronically.
